description: No automerge: every commit on main is released to PyPI, so each dependency update must be merged deliberately.
Lockfile maintenance runs monthly and is never merged automatically; lockfile-only changes do not affect users of the package.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Python packages: minor and patch in one PR
GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks: minor, patch and digest in one PR
